main_text.p: pruriginem vehementer coarguit ; qui-bus etiam accedit, gravissimas tunc tem-poris de Sacramento confirmationis di-sputationes in Gallia extitisse inter Petrum Aurelium seu Sancyranum, & Sirmon-dum Jesuitam doctissimum; fortan ægre-tulit Morinus, Aurelii sententiam, cui nihil inerat probabilitatis, ab omnibus fere Theologis approbari: Sirmondum vero, qui argumentum illud diligenter tractaverat, partes executus Theologi rei Criticæ peritissimi a plerisque despectum fuisse. Tractatus autem ille, cui titulus; de disciplina à Patribus[?] observata inexpiatio-ne catechumenorum, primam ejus commentariorum de Sacramento pœnitentiæ partem occupare debebat, ut etiam ex Bi-bliopola didici, qui illum à Morino acceperat cum reliquo opere, ut ederetur; sed à Theologis Parisiensibus rejectus fuit, qui Morino opposuerunt tractatu isto receptam Ecclesiæ traditionem de Sa-cramento pœnitentiæ; atque in primis Doctrinam Confessionis Sacramentalis penitus everti. Morinum à Nihusio

page.notes: Catchword "consultum" at the lower right is the first word of the next page. Possible misprint or unclear letters: "Patribus" (printed with a doubtful final letter) and "fortan", which may be a truncated "fortasse"; both are read as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The text of the title and "ne catechumenorum" carries the printer's hyphen after "inexpiatio".
